newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat unchanged in slow market.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat unchanged in slow market.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat prices, both spot and new crop, were unchanged in slow trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, traders said.

There was a general lack of news, leaving most grains trade with little direction. April maize edged up in tight trade, with exporters having to up bids to squeeze supply into the market. Spot maize was mixed in good volume, with local buyers supported by higher chicken prices and the proximity of the festive season. Cash soybeans were unchanged in moderate volume trade undisturbed by any new market factors. Cash March sunflower seed rose on firm oil prices in moderate volume.
